spec: Token tables for declared-unit-only normalization (METHODOLOGY §4: unit normalization uses only the model's declared unit string, never the value's magnitude). Consumed by lib.mjs normalizeDeclaredUnit. Tokens are matched after lowercasing, NFKC normalization, $/US$ -> 'usd', '%' isolation, and punctuation stripping.
notes: 'per'/'capita' rejected for level-kind so a per-capita figure declared as such is answer_failure, not a silently wrong level.
'ppp'/'constant'/'real' rejected for level-kind: the GDP question asks current US$ at market rates.
Currency tokens other than USD rejected: level ground truth is current US$ (or people/years).
percent-kind path never consults neutral/rejected tables (any token set containing a percent token normalizes with factor 1, bps with 0.01), matching lib.mjs normalizeDeclaredUnit.
